name: Equipment failure risk
task: Probability that a pump fails within 14 days, with the readings driving it.
algorithm: Gradient boosting (scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting) with monotonic constraints from pump physics; native handling of missing sensors
data: Simulated fleet: 700 pumps x 540 days of wear, servicing and failures (irrigaiq_ml/equipment/simulator.py).
interpretation: Failures are random events even for a worn pump, so no model can foresee most of them. The fair yardstick is the ceiling (scoring with each pump's true hidden wear): the model reaches 99% of its ROC AUC. At the rules' catch rate it is 23% more precise, and adds a calibrated 14-day probability, a smooth ranking and tolerance of missing sensors.
limitations: Trained on simulated degradation, not on failures of real IrrigaIQ pumps.
Physically plausible but idealised: real pumps fail in ways the simulation does not model.
Complements, not replaces, the explainable health score; retrain on real telemetry and maintenance records once a season of data exists.
